artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan to break the Core<->Bundle cycle, migrate the live ModalSaturation helpers, retire a six-file dead set to the archive, and restore documentation coherence.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan retires live-tree Lean modules into FormalSystem/Boneyard/, check the archive's tree-wide convention banner before moving. Boneyard/README.md asserts every archived file is EVENT-FIRST (predating the guard-first untl/snce migration) and instructs anyone resurrecting a file to swap both arguments. Files retired from the live tree today are guard-first, so moving them in without a named per-directory carve-out makes the banner silently false in exactly the way it warns about -- applying its swap instruction to them inverts their meaning while still compiling. Verify with `grep -c 'untl\|snce'` on each retiring file; a nonzero count obliges the carve-out. This class of defect is invisible to check-module-invariants.sh: C11 checks that archived imports resolve, never the semantics of archived content.
